name: yew
lore_descriptor: tight-grained, red-hearted; smells faintly of churchyards
first_pickup_chronicle: Yew. The English longbow wood. Planted in graveyards because the wood took longer to grow than the people buried under it. Fey hate it.
design_notes: F10 peak — wood equivalent of iron. effective_against fey (yew was planted as a fairy-ward in old churchyards). bow_capable: ideal for shortbow/longbow. damage_mult 0.95 — wood gives slightly under metal but the fey-bonus carries it.
